messages:
tom: Heads-up RFC follow-up: we need a clearer contract for precision-escalation budgets. Current fallback storms at busy times.
anne: +1. we saw a spike yesterday where many requests flipped from fp8 -> int8 -> 4bit -> fallback to cpu, thrashing latency.
kyle: root cause seemed to be aggressive probe sampling + no global budget. Suggest adding `probe_budget_per_route` and a global `escalation_quota` with windowed counters.
sara: also add hysteresis by token position. early tokens are high-signal; later tokens can tolerate lower precision. Idea: per-request hint `min_reliable_tokens` so runtime can delay escalation until after N tokens.
tom: nice. sketching schema idea:
```
precision_escalation: {
  probe_budget_per_min: 100,          # probes allowed per minute per route
  escalation_quota_window_s: 300,    # sliding window seconds
  max_concurrent_escalations: 8,     # avoid thundering herd
  token_hysteresis: {
    enabled: true,
    min_tokens_before_escalate: 3
  }
}
```
anne: edge cases: (1) short-completion prompts (<5 tokens) will never trigger if min_tokens_before_escalate too high. We'll need route overrides.
kyle: runtime complexity: tracking counters across machines requires a centralized rate-limiter (redis) or probabilistic local budgets with occasional reconciliation. Prefer local tokens + periodic refill to avoid single point.
sara: telemetry: capture `escalation_decision` events with fields: route, reason (quality|latency|quota), from_precision, to_precision, decision_latency_ms. We'll use these to tune quotas.
tom: for canary: enable on internal tenants only with `escalation_quota_window_s=60` and probe_budget 10/min. Shadow evaluate quality on 100% of requests but only actuate on sampled ones.
opsbot: deploybot: feature-flag `escalation-budget` enabled for staging at 2024-09-02T09:12Z :white_check_mark:
anne: tests: simulate a poisson arrival with burst factor 10 and verify max_concurrent_escalations cap holds. Add unit for token_hysteresis with short/long prompts.
kyle: security note: no customer data leaves runtime for probe; shadow eval must use obfuscated prompts if stored. Document this in privacy checklist.
sara: I'll draft the telemetry dashboard (counts, false-escalation rate, latency delta) and thresholds for automatic rollback.
tom: action list: 1) schema PR + migration notes 2) naive local-budget prototype (kyle) 3) telemetry event spec (sara) 4) canary playbook (anne). I'll open the PR and tag folks. :rocket:
